summary: Frontend-only validation of R-BL-3 QueueStatusPill visibility layer after main agent added the missing import in App.js. All 3 functional states (Synced/Queued/Failed) plus last-sync timestamp behavior validated via IndexedDB seed + reload. The import fix is working — no 'QueueStatusPill is not defined' or ReferenceError. UI renders as designed.

test_results.STATE_2_queued_2_items: PASS — amber [data-testid='queue-status-pill-queued'] renders with aria-label 'Pending Uploads: 2'. Drawer opens on click. Both queue-item-TEST_q1 and queue-item-TEST_q2 render with form type ('Daily Report', 'Incident Report'), project names ('Project Alpha', 'Project Bravo'), queued time ('QUEUED 3:44 AM'), retry count ('RETRY 1 OF 5' / 'RETRY 2 OF 5'), PENDING badge, and lastError shown. queue-drawer-retry-all is enabled (no disabled attr). queue-drawer-close successfully closes the drawer. Screenshot confirms full layout.
test_results.STATE_3_failed_item: PASS — red [data-testid='queue-status-pill-failed'] renders with aria-label 'Attention Required'. Drawer shows 'NEEDS ATTENTION' red badge, italic notice 'This submission could not be delivered automatically.', and lastError 'HTTP 500 — service unreachable'. Retry-all button has bg-red-700 styling.
test_results.STATE_4_last_sync_timestamp: PARTIAL — queue-last-sync renders formatted date 'Jan 12, 2026, 2:30 PM' (not '—'/'Never Synced') when lastSync set in localStorage. HOWEVER: reviewer's stated expectation ('after queue empties + lastSync present, pill should be hidden again') CONTRADICTS the component code. Per QueueStatusPill.jsx line 135 (`if (state === 'synced' && !lastSync) return null;`), the synced state IS shown when lastSync exists — a green disabled 'All Reports Synced' pill renders. Observed: data-testid='queue-status-pill-synced' is present after clearing queue while lastSync remains. This is a spec-vs-code discrepancy — the code's behavior appears intentional (doctrine comment refers to platform-wide trust visibility), but it does not match the reviewer's written assertion. Main agent should clarify desired semantics.
test_results.NON_REGRESSION_console_errors: PASS — Total console errors: 0. No 'QueueStatusPill is not defined' or ReferenceError. Hub home page renders cleanly with the import addition.

spec_vs_code_observation: Reviewer's STATE 4 final clause expects synced+lastSync to hide the pill, but component code only hides when synced AND !lastSync. When lastSync exists, a non-interactive green 'All Reports Synced' pill is rendered (button disabled, cursor-default). This is likely intentional design (persistent trust signal once sync has ever occurred) and is NOT a regression — but it is a documentation discrepancy in the testing request.
action_items: Decide whether the persistent green 'All Reports Synced' pill (queue empty + lastSync present) is the intended final-state behavior. If reviewer's spec is authoritative, change QueueStatusPill.jsx line 135 to `if (state === 'synced') return null;`. If the code is authoritative, update the spec wording. NO functional bug; visibility-only decision.
critical_code_review_comments: QueueStatusPill.jsx correctly isolates as a pure visibility layer — only calls onQueueChange / getQueueItems / drainQueue exports; never mutates queue state. Doctrine respected.

All required data-testids present: queue-status-pill-{synced|queued|failed}, queue-status-drawer, queue-status-drawer-backdrop, queue-drawer-close, queue-last-sync, queue-items, queue-item-{id}, queue-drawer-retry-all.

Successful-drain heuristic (line 87: `prev.length > next.length`) writes lastSync timestamp. This is reasonable but will also fire on any depth-decrease event including a user manually purging the queue from devtools — minor edge case, acceptable.
drainQueue() called from onRetry catches errors silently; the only feedback is the spinning icon. Acceptable for a visibility-only layer.
i18n keys (`t('Pending Uploads')`, `t('Attention Required')`, etc.) wired correctly; aria-labels carry the translated text for screen readers.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 functional states behave correctly; STATE 4 has a spec-vs-code discrepancy only)
